trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: No block-final restatement of already-established content
'The Hecke algebra under the Markov trace operates as a (W*, tr) probability space' restates the opening sentence, but adds the W*-algebra qualifier.

trap-performed-warmth.evidence: Institutional register throughout; no personal warmth

trap-superlative.notes: Citation flags reported separately: the sentence attributing the q-deformed result to Feray--Meliot carries the key marsh2006, which is Marsh--Fuentes--Moyano--Tsallis, 'Influence of global correlations on central limit theorems and entropic extensivity' (Physica A) -- not Feray--Meliot; and the .ts cites [biane1998, blitvic2012] does not list marsh2006 while the .md never cites blitvic2012.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: Sentences short and speakable; no noun-chain pileups

trap-nonspeakable.notes: Register note: 'operates as' is used twice where 'is' would serve ('The Kashaev volume conjecture operates as a free-entropy log-asymptotic'; 'The Hecke algebra ... operates as a (W*, tr) probability space') -- the mild end of the verb-substitution pattern seen in ns-kummer-specialisation.
